name: ashermanwmf/pageviewapi
what_it_holds: Small client/wrapper for Wikimedia's official Pageviews API, returning per-article, per-day pageview counts back to mid-2015.
why_useful: Matches CONTEXT gap #5 ('Wikipedia pageviews tooling') directly; Wikipedia pageviews for 'Airbnb', 'short-term rental', competitor articles, or destination-city articles are a free, long-history, point-in-time-clean (pageviews are immutable once logged) engagement/interest proxy that has not been tested by the team yet.
size_hint: client only, API pull required for data

name: rohitgodbole/WikiPageviews
what_it_holds: A thin wrapper (0 stars) around the official Wikimedia Pageviews API, updated as recently as 26 Apr 2026.
why_useful: CONTEXT gap #5 flags 'Wikipedia pageviews tooling' explicitly; pageviews for 'Airbnb', 'Vrbo', destination-city pages, or 'short-term rental' articles are free, dated-by-day, genuinely point-in-time (the API returns historical daily counts as originally recorded) and could proxy search/engagement interest as an alternative to non-point-in-time Google Trends. The official Wikimedia REST pageviews API itself (no wrapper needed) is the more load-bearing artifact here; this repo is just one thin client example.
time_coverage: Wikimedia pageviews API covers July 2015-present daily/hourly, official and point-in-time

name: andreaponti5/revscrap
what_it_holds: A Python Dash web app that scrapes reviews for both the Google Play Store and the Apple App Store for any given app, not Airbnb-specific.
why_useful: Generic, reusable method to build an Airbnb-mobile-app review-volume/rating-over-time series (a public engagement/download proxy) addressing gap #5 (app rankings/engagement history), which is otherwise hard to get free historical data for; would need to be pointed at the Airbnb app IDs on each store.
themes: Airbnb reviews text corpora and review-date datasets on GitHub (review counts over time as a stays proxy)
why_all: Generic, reusable method to build an Airbnb-mobile-app review-volume/rating-over-time series (a public engagement/download proxy) addressing gap #5 (app rankings/engagement history), which is otherwise hard to get free historical data for; would need to be pointed at the Airbnb app IDs on each store.

name: katacek/google-play-reviews
what_it_holds: Generic scraper that pulls Google Play Store app user reviews (name, date, text) into a dataset given an app URL/ID; not Airbnb-specific, no data committed.
why_useful: Same use case as revscrap above: could be re-pointed at Airbnb's own Play Store listing to build a review-count/date-stamped engagement time series as a demand-adjacent signal (gap #5).
themes: Airbnb reviews text corpora and review-date datasets on GitHub (review counts over time as a stays proxy)
why_all: Same use case as revscrap above: could be re-pointed at Airbnb's own Play Store listing to build a review-count/date-stamped engagement time series as a demand-adjacent signal (gap #5).

name: reviews-dashboard
what_it_holds: Full-stack dashboard aggregating reviews across Airbnb/Hostaway and Google for a property manager's own listings. Requires the operator's own API keys/business accounts; no public dataset.
why_useful: Not directly usable (needs a manager's own accounts), but demonstrates that Hostaway exposes normalized cross-platform review data, which is the kind of thing a cooperating STR manager could export if the team found one willing to share.
themes: Property-management / channel-manager / PMS public data (Guesty, Hostaway, Lodgify, OwnerRez, Hostfully, Smoobu, Beds24, iCal feeds) and vacation-rental manager benchmarks
why_all: Not directly usable (needs a manager's own accounts), but demonstrates that Hostaway exposes normalized cross-platform review data, which is the kind of thing a cooperating STR manager could export if the team found one willing to share.
